title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.


Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.


THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.



What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.


Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.


Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.


By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.


OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

Own model decisions regarding the selection of foundation models for specific tasks and the acceptable trade-offs between latency and accuracy.

Architect data pipelines in collaboration with Data Engineers to curate high-quality synthetic data and improve model training efficiency.

Solve complex 'hallucination' problems by serving as the final escalation point for enhancing model factuality and designing logic for retrievers and re-rankers.

Mentor the team by translating the latest research papers into actionable engineering tickets.


Qualification Required

Extensive experience with PyTorch and the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, PEFT, Accelerate).

Proven track record of fine-tuning models, with a deep understanding of attention mechanisms, positional embeddings, and transformer architectures.

Hands-on experience with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and familiarity with the mathematics behind similarity search and embedding models.

Proficiency in Python, along with familiarity in containerization (Docker) and cloud-scale Al training (AWS SageMaker/GCP Vertex Al).

Ability to analyze model failures, hypothesize root causes, and systematically test solutions.


Nice to Have

Advanced Degree: A Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Math, or a related field with a focus on NLP.

Multi-Modal Experience: Familiarity with Vision-Language Models (VLM) or audio-to-text integration.

Reinforcement Learning: Experience with RLHF (Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback) or DPO (Direct Preference Optimization).

Open Source Presence: A portfolio of public GitHub repos, Hugging Face models, or published papers in the GenAl space.

Hardware Knowledge: Deep understanding of NVIDIA GPU architectures (H100/A100) and CUDA kernels to maximize hardware utilization.

Our client is a people-focused organization dedicated to developing impactful products and services that create meaningful value for customers and communities. They foster a collaborative, respectful, and inclusive work environment where employees are encouraged to take ownership, contribute ideas, and grow professionally. The company supports flexibility and work–life balance while maintaining strong performance and accountability standards.

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.


About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e análise de portfólio e projetos (Excel avançado, SAP, Power BI, MS Project).

title: Engenheiro de Software Senior Backend (Ruby on Rails)
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial.

O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida.

Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento.

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:

1.Desenvolvimento e Entrega Técnica

  • Construção da API Core: Desenvolver e manter endpoints RESTful eficientes utilizando Ruby on Rails para suportar as aplicações Web e Mobile.
  • Escrita de Testes Automatizados: Garantir a estabilidade do sistema através de testes de integração e unitários (RSpec), utilizando VCR e WebMock para garantir que as dependências externas não atrasem o pipeline.
  • Otimização de Performance: Garantir que a API seja rápida e escalável, aplicando boas práticas de banco de dados (PostgreSQL) e evitando gargalos de processamento


2. Integração e Homologação (Foco em Qualidade)

  • Validação de Integração: Testar e homologar ativamente as interações da API com o desenvolvimento Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os dados trafegados estejam corretos e performáticos.
  • Garantia de Eficiência: Assegurar a máxima qualidade no processo de integração, antecipando falhas de contrato de dados e garantindo que as funcionalidades atendam aos requisitos de UI/UX de ambos os clientes.
  • Definição de Contratos: Colaborar no desenho técnico prévio dos endpoints para garantir que o time de Front-end tenha mocks funcionais e especificações claras, minimizando o retrabalho.


3. Colaboração e Alinhamento

  • Gestão de Bloqueios: Atuar de forma proativa para identificar e comunicar impedimentos técnicos que possam impactar o cronograma de 3 meses.
  • Code Review: Participar de revisões de código focadas em manter o padrão de qualidade da equipe e a consistência do \"Rails Way\".


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Evolução Profissional: Manter-se atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, trazendo as melhores práticas de segurança e arquitetura para o projeto a longo prazo.
  • Aprimoramento de Processos: Analisar constantemente o ciclo de desenvolvimento e propor melhorias que tornem o fluxo de deploy e a integração com o front-end mais ágeis.


5. Documentação e Sustentabilidade

  • Documentação Técnica: Manter uma documentação clara e atualizada da API (ex: Swagger/OpenAPI) para servir como fonte única de verdade para os times de consumo.
  • Manutenibilidade: Equilibrar o pragmatismo da entrega rápida com a saúde do código, garantindo uma base sólida para a evolução permanente do produto.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:


  • Dominam Ruby on Rails (Modo API): Domínio profundo do framework, priorizando o \"Rails Way\" e o uso de scaffolding eficiente para velocidade de entrega.
  • Têm experiência em Design de API RESTful: Experiência em estruturar endpoints que atendam simultaneamente Web e Mobile (JSON, paginação, versionamento).
  • Têm experiência em Testes e Mocking (RSpec): Domínio de VCR e WebMock para simular interações externas de forma determinística, garantindo uma suíte de testes rápida e confiável.
  • Têm experiência em Modelagem de Dados: Experiência com PostgreSQL e uso eficiente de Active Record (evitando o problema de N+1).
  • Têm experiência com Autenticação e Segurança: Implementação prática de JWT ou Devise Token Auth.
  • Têm Pragmatismo e Foco: Foco em resolver o problema de negócio com a solução mais simples e direta, evitando \"overengineering\".

description:

Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada.

Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT; studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore; e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária.


Principais responsabilidades:

1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura

  • Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\"The Rails Way\"), garantindo que a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile.
  • Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura.
  • Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog.


2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação

  • Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima.
  • Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção.
  • Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento.


3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance

  • Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva.
  • Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app.


4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua

  • Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas.
  • Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código.


O que buscamos

Pessoas que:

  • Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção.
  • Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile.
  • Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos.
  • Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance.
  • Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean).
  • Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação.
  • Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando \"overengineering\".
  • Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante.
  • Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios.
  • Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção.
  • Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job description

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join a North American team supporting a hybrid environment with a strong focus on VMware and Azure Cloud. This role is primarily hands-on and involves managing, modernizing, and migrating a large-scale virtualized environment to the cloud, while also supporting core networking and security components. The ideal candidate brings deep VMware and Azure experience, strong production support capabilities, and the ability to work across infrastructure, cloud, and networking domains in a collaborative, hybrid-specialist team.


Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage and optimize a large VMware environment across multiple physical hosts.
  • Support migration initiatives from on-premises VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.
  • Design and implement cloud-based solutions in Azure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.
  • Build and maintain disaster recovery strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Administer and support VMware platforms, including vCenter, vSAN, and related virtualization components.
  • Support and manage Microsoft 365 (O365) services within the broader infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues across virtualized, cloud, and network layers.
  • Support networking components including firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure access solutions.
  • Work with security platforms such as Zscaler and contribute to overall infrastructure security posture.
  • Participate in modernization projects aimed at improving system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional IT and security teams to align infrastructure with business needs.
  • Maintain accurate technical documentation, system diagrams, and operational procedures.


Job Requirements

  • 8–10+ years of hands-on experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Strong expertise in VMware technologies (vSphere, vCenter, vSAN) in production environments.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including migrations, compute, networking, and storage services.
  • Proven experience managing and supporting large virtualized environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing disaster recovery solutions across hybrid infrastructures.
  • Working knowledge of core networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and switching.
  • Experience with secure access and SASE platforms such as Zscaler is preferred.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 (O365) administration.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud, and networking layers.
  • Experience with performance monitoring tools and infrastructure observability.
  • Ability to work in a hybrid specialist team and handle multiple responsibilities across domains.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to prioritize work in a dynamic environment.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., VMware, Azure, CCNP) are preferred but not mandatory if experience is strong.

description:

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Medical Monitor who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

  • Collaborate with physicians, scientists, regulatory professionals, biostatisticians, regulatory, executive staff and others in a complex matrix environment to develop and execute phase 1-3 interventional clinical trials
  • Ensure high quality protocol development aligned with the Clinical Development Plan to effectively determine a medicine’s potential efficacy, safety profile, key areas of product differentiation and value to patient in the shortest possible timeframe.
  • Use medical expertise to contribute to the end to end (protocol concept to final study report) to ensure scientific integrity and timely delivery of clinical trials which ensure consistency with the clinical development strategy for regulatory approvals, reimbursable medicines, and successful lifecycle management; demonstrate ability to incorporate global considerations into decision making
  • Interpret and summarize study results consistent with objectives to define safety, efficacy, pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamic, and patient reported outcomes, and applicability of data to the targeted patient population.
  • Assume medical responsibility for clinical trials with active participation in real-time medical monitoring of studies, including patient eligibility assessment, study design questions, and addressing urgent safety questions (with inclusion of Safety/ PV as relevant).
  • Assume responsibility for medical review of clinical trial data, both directly as needed and/or via oversight of delegated medical review. Oversee blinded review of data packages intended for IDMCs.
  • Review/monitor safety data in collaboration with pharmacovigilance group for active clinical studies.
  • Participate in the authoring of clinical study reports and regulatory documents and collaborate with colleagues in Regulatory Affairs, CMC, Toxicology, Research, Pharmacology to respond to health authority and ethics committee queries.
  • Collaborate with Principal Investigators in the evaluation and assessment of publications (abstracts, posters, manuscripts) associated with clinical data.

Location: Remote (Brazil)

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Financial Reporting Analyst tto support financial reporting, analysis, and data-driven decision-making, ensuring accuracy, visibility, and actionable insights across the business.


Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Financial Reporting Analyst / Accountant to support financial reporting, accounting operations, and data-driven decision-making across the organization.

This role bridges financial reporting and accounting, ensuring accurate financial records, reliable reporting, and actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong accounting fundamentals with analytical capabilities, contributing to both operational excellence and strategic visibility.


What You'll Do

  • Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports
  • Maintain accuracy and integrity of financial data across reports and systems
  • Support general accounting activities, including reconciliations and journal entries
  • Ensure proper classification and recording of financial transactions
  • Assist in month-end and year-end close processes
  • Identify trends, variances, and key drivers of financial performance
  • Deliver insights to support business and financial decision-making
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather and validate financial data
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with accounting standards and policies
  • Improve financial reporting processes, tools, and documentation
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis and support finance-related initiatives


What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial reporting, accounting, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of financial statements and accounting principles
  • Experience with month-end close and reconciliations
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or accounting systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work with large datasets and translate data into insights
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally


Nice to Have

  • CPA or equivalent certification (or in progress)
  • Experience with financial reporting tools or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Tableau)
  • Familiarity with financial controls and compliance processes
  • Experience in high-growth or scaling environments

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation

title: VFX- Subject Matter Expert
description:
VFX- Fully Remote Subject Matter Expert


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting 3D Artists and VFX experts with experience creating computer generated scenes and assets to join our global network for a high level gaming project.


Rather than traditional VFX work, we are offering an opportunity to licence existing ‘on-the-shelf’ works from your archives, plus hourly compensation for technical processing.


What You Will Be Doing:

  • Asset licencing: Licence existing works from your personal/ studio archives for a flat fee
  • Technical processing including rendering, layering, and preparing these files to our data specifications
  • In some cases, making variations to scenes and re-rendering


Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching


What You’ll Bring

  • Experience as a 3D, Technical or VFX Artist or Compositor in games, film or digital production
  • Experience with Unreal Engine, Unity & Houdini, Maya / Blender / Cinema4D and similar
  • Expertise in rendering, lighting and texturing
  • Comfortable using technical workflows and tools
  • Existing assets for licensing, with scenes separated into coherent, compositable layers


Nice To Have

  • Experience in the Gaming industry
  • Elements including depth, albedo, shading, gloss, cryptomat
  • Complex occlusions, atmospherics and crowd dynamics


Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again; simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for opportunities.



Why join this project?

This is an opportunity to licence your existing assets and to apply your expertise in VFX design on a flexible, ad hoc basis, in order to help improve AI systems for video generation with better controllability for creators.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.


Links to more information on Prolific

Website

Youtube


Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Server Manager (Global Project) [Inglês Avançado]
description:
Estamos em busca de um Server Manager altamente qualificado para integrar nossa equipe de Enhanced Operation Service (EOS), que faz parte da organização de Enterprise Cloud Services Delivery. Neste papel, você atuará como um consultor de confiança, sendo responsável por salvaguardar e otimizar a entrega de ponta a ponta para clientes estratégicos durante sua jornada de transformação em nuvem.

Você fará parte de um projeto global , integrando um time que atua em uma operação 24x7 para um cliente da Tech Mahindra. Esta é uma posição remota, com alocação mínima prevista de um ano. O horário inicial será de segunda a sexta-feira, das 9h às 18h, porém a escala é passível de alteração ao longo do projeto para atender às necessidades operacionais.


Principais Responsabilidades

Seu trabalho envolverá uma carga de trabalho mista, com foco em manter a estabilidade e a performance do sistema:

  • Gestão de Incidentes e Problemas: Participar ativamente no tratamento de incidentes críticos (Major Incidents), solucionar falhas em solicitações de serviço e realizar análise de causa raiz (RCA) para interrupções ou problemas de desempenho.
  • Solicitações de Serviço e Mudança: Executar solicitações de serviço e mudanças complexas, gerenciando extensões de tempo de inatividade e incidentes de longa duração.
  • Otimização de Performance: Identificar e liderar iniciativas proativas para melhorar a operação, estabilidade e padronização dos sistemas dos clientes.
  • Suporte Técnico Especializado: Fornecer suporte técnico especializado em Linux e infraestrutura, com foco em solução de problemas de disco, servidor e conectividade de rede.
  • Melhoria Contínua: Otimizar procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) por meio de automação e definir planos de ação corretiva para atingir os KPIs estabelecidos.
  • Orquestração e Colaboração: Coordenar o trabalho entre diversas unidades de serviços de nuvem, internos e externos, garantindo uma entrega contínua.


Requisitos Técnicos Centrais

  • Expertise em Linux (Obrigatório): Sólida experiência prática em administração de SUSE, Red Hat ou Ubuntu . É essencial ter vivência real em troubleshooting de performance, disco e sistema.
  • Clustering & HA (Obrigatório - Flexível): Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em configurações de Alta Disponibilidade (HA). Conhecimento em Pacemaker é preferencial, mas outras ferramentas de clustering (como Red Hat HA) são aceitáveis.
  • Proficiência em Nuvem (Obrigatório): Experiência prática em pelo menos um dos principais provedores de nuvem pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP . Experiência em ambientes multi-cloud será considerada um diferencial.
  • Redes: Capacidade avançada para diagnosticar problemas de rede em ambiente Linux e nuvem, incluindo TCP/IP, DNS, LDAP, NAT, firewalls e análise de conectividade.
  • Automação: Experiência com linguagens de script (Shell, Python, Go, etc.) e ferramentas de automação de servidores como Ansible ou CHEF .


Qualificações e Experiência

  • Experiência Profissional: Mínimo 8 a 10 anos de experiência na área de infraestrutura de TI e operações de servidores.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Gestão de TI ou áreas correlatas.
  • Idioma: Inglês Fluente é imprescindível, dado que toda a interação com o time global, documentação e suporte ao cliente será realizada em inglês.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Foco no cliente, pensamento analítico orientado a soluções e capacidade de adquirir novos conhecimentos de forma independente e proativa.


Imporante:

Inglês é Mandatório.

title: Senior Customer Education
description:
About the Role


Our education platform is a central learning hub for both customers and internal teams. With a large and growing base of users, we’ve reached a point where we need to scale the program more intentionally — with more structured learning paths, meaningful certifications, and content that directly connects to product adoption and retention.

We are looking for someone who combines strategic vision with strong execution skills: someone who can design an end-to-end educational program and turn it into measurable business results.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture of the education program — learning paths, certifications, and journeys aligned with the customer lifecycle and different user profiles
  • Develop and maintain courses and learning paths with high instructional quality and strong alignment with the product, in both Portuguese and English
  • Script educational videos and collaborate with recording and editing teams to ensure production consistency
  • Create and execute engagement strategies to convert users into active learners and drive progression through learning paths
  • Define and monitor program KPIs — activation, completion, and active engagement — connecting learning behavior to retention and expansion metrics
  • Turn usage data into portfolio decisions: what to prioritize, update, or discontinue
  • Collaborate with Product, Customer Success, and Support teams to keep content up to date and identify knowledge gaps that impact adoption
  • Support internal enablement initiatives


Requirements

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in customer education, instructional design, or e-learning — preferably in B2B SaaS
  • Experience managing educational programs within LMS platforms (not just operating them, but designing structure and analyzing data)
  • Ability to connect learning behavior to business metrics such as adoption, retention, and expansion
  • Experience scripting and producing educational videos independently
  • Fluent communication in Portuguese and English — able to create and script content in both languages
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to educational content production workflows


Nice to Have

  • Previous experience in B2B SaaS
  • Experience with Product-Led Growth (PLG) and Sales-Led Growth (SLG) models
  • Experience with product education and scalable learning programs
  • Experience with user reactivation strategies or engagement management in educational programs
  • Strategic use of AI to optimize content production, curation, and updates

title: Revley Payments Engineer — Stripe Connect / White-Label Payments Platform
description:
Company Description

Revley is the commerce operating system for the next generation of subscription brands. Headquartered in Manhattan. Bootstrapped. Profitable.


We exist because the modern commerce stack is broken. Brands stitch together a checkout from one vendor, a subscription engine from another, a payment processor from a third, a chargeback tool from a fourth — and spend more time managing the seams than growing. We replace all of it. One platform. Payments, subscriptions, checkout, tokenization, analytics, and revenue protection — unified, owned by the merchant, portable across every processor.


Our largest merchant processes $20M/month. In 8 months we've signed enterprise contracts with 12 partners including Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex, Nuvei, NMI, Finix, Braintree, and Authorize.net. Brands using Revley don't rent their payment infrastructure. They own it.


We move fast, ship daily, and treat every merchant relationship like the one that defines the company. We value ownership, transparency, and craftsmanship over process. We build for ambitious teams the way we'd want to be built for. If you've ever looked at the commerce stack and thought this should be one thing, not ten — you already understand Revley.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Payments Engineer specializing in Stripe Connect and white-label payments platforms at Revley. The role includes designing, building, and optimizing scalable payment infrastructure, integrating Stripe Connect, and enabling white-label payment solutions. This engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure secure and seamless payment processing, proactively identify and address technical challenges, and stay updated with emerging payment technologies.


Qualifications

  • Experience with Stripe Connect, white-label payment solutions, and payment system design
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as JavaScript, Python, or Ruby for payment platform development
  • Hands-on experience with API integrations and handling webhooks
  • Understanding of PCI compliance, data security, and regulations related to payment processing
  • Strong problem-solving skills with an ability to address technical challenges in payment operations
  • Collaboration skills to work cross-functionally with product and design teams
  • Previous experience with subscription or SaaS-based business models is a plus
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent field is preferred

The Dispatcher acts as the link between customers, cleaners, and management, ensuring smooth daily operations, proper documentation, and customer satisfaction. 


Key Responsibilities:  

  • Prior experience in dispatch, scheduling, or logistics.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
  • Excellent communication with both customers and field staff.
  • Ability to manage stress and resolve scheduling conflicts in real time.
  • Proficiency in BookingKoala CRM, OpenPhone, RingCentral, and Google Workspace.
  • Attention to detail with clock-in/out monitoring, photo uploads, and reports.
  • Ability to hire, train, and oversee service providers.
  • English fluency; Spanish preferred (Los Angeles/Miami markets).
  • Flexibility to cover evenings and weekends as required.


DUTIES


Scheduling & Daily Dispatch


  • Assign daily jobs to cleaners in BookingKoala.
  • Monitor same-day jobs to ensure start times are met.
  • Confirm cleaner clock-in/clock-out and require before/after photos.
  • For Airbnb clients: collect damage reports, supply alerts, and before/after pictures.
  • Verify next-day schedules with both clients and cleaners.
  • Maintain updated cleaner calendars (minimum two weeks ahead).


Customer & Cleaner Support


  • Answer incoming calls and resolve service-related questions.
  • Provide cleaners with clear instructions (special notes, supplies, reporting requirements).
  • Handle reschedules and urgent client requests.
  • Conduct Happy Calls after cleanings to confirm satisfaction.


Sales & Overflow Coverage


  • Take incoming sales calls when CSR is unavailable.
  • Send quotes and update CRM as needed.
  • Support upselling and follow-ups when covering evening/weekend shifts.


Hiring & Onboarding


  • Conduct weekly recruiting campaigns (e.g., Care.com and other sources).
  • Call at least 15 leads per week and conduct 6+ interviews.
  • Onboard 3–5 qualified cleaners weekly across Los Angeles (Pacific Time) and Miami (Eastern Time).
  • Send onboarding emails and guides, set up training schedules.
  • Collect W-9 forms and proof of insurance from all regular providers.
  • Develop and update provider SOPs and training materials.


Quality & Performance Management


  • Review provider performance, verify documentation, and ensure SOP compliance.
  • Identify top performers and support bonus/recognition processes.
  • Escalate and resolve quality issues promptly.


Reporting & Communication


  • Update daily scorecards for Los Angeles and Miami.
  • Provide Slack updates summarizing daily dispatch results.
  • Attend HSA Sales/Training calls.
  • Document missed calls and unresponsive customers in shared sheets.


Systems & Process Management


  • Maintain a dedicated phone line for cleaner communication (separate from client and lead lines).
  • Continuously improve onboarding, communication, and SOP processes.

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. A CHS busca um(a) Gerente Administrativo, Financeiro e Supply Chain para atuar em uma posição estratégica, com forte interface internacional e impacto direto na eficiência das operações logísticas na América Latina.

Esta posição terá papel fundamental como elo entre a operação na Europa e a América Latina , garantindo alinhamento de processos, governança e execução operacional. Além disso, será um(a) parceiro(a) direto(a) do líder da operação LatAm, participando ativamente de discussões estratégicas e tomada de decisão.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Atuar como ponto focal entre as operações europeias e latino-americanas , assegurando alinhamento de práticas, políticas e diretrizes corporativas
  • Liderar as frentes administrativa, financeira e de supply chain na região
  • Gerenciar e otimizar o fluxo de entrada, circulação e saída de containers nos portos da região atendida
  • Garantir eficiência operacional e controle de custos logísticos
  • Conduzir e apoiar discussões relacionadas a processos alfandegários, tributários e jurídicos , assegurando compliance e mitigação de riscos
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders internos e externos (portos, despachantes, operadores logísticos, áreas legais e fiscais)
  • Participar ativamente de fóruns estratégicos com a liderança LatAm, contribuindo com análises e recomendações para melhoria contínua da operação
  • Desenvolver e acompanhar indicadores de performance (KPIs) financeiros e operacionais

Perfil Desejado

  • Experiência consolidada em posições de liderança nas áreas administrativa, financeira e/ou supply chain , preferencialmente em empresas de logística, trading ou agronegócio
  • Forte conhecimento em operações portuárias e logística internacional (containers)
  • Experiência com temas alfandegários, tributários e jurídicos aplicados à logística internacional
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente matricial e multicultural, com interface internacional (especialmente Europa)
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e com visão estratégica
  • Habilidade de influência e comunicação com alta liderança

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em empresas globais ou com operações intercontinentais
  • Vivência em projetos de integração entre regiões (Europa–LatAm)
  • Conhecimento em regulamentações específicas de comércio exterior na América Latina;
  • Profissional Argentino residente no Rio de Janeiro

Por que essa posição é estratégica?

Essa função é chave para garantir a fluidez das operações logísticas internacionais da CHS , conectando diferentes geografias, assegurando compliance regulatório e promovendo eficiência operacional. Além disso, terá papel decisivo na construção e evolução da estratégia da operação LatAm , atuando lado a lado com a liderança regional.

title: Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo
description:
Mackay Marine é uma empresa global de serviço eletrônicos marítimos com mais de 450 funcionários em 45 depósitos de serviços em 17 países, incluindo Américas, Europa, África e Ásia. Por mais de cinquenta (50) anos, a Mackay vendeu, instalou e atendeu equipamentos de navegação e comunicação a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. A Mackay garante o sucesso de nossos funcionários investindo em treinamento contínuo na fábrica e fornecendo todas as peças, suporte técnico e administrativo necessários. Também oferecemos salários competitivos, horas extras, benefícios e oportunidades de crescimento com base no mérito.


A Mackay Marine Brasil atualmente tem vagas em nossas localidade do Rio para Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo com experiência, habilidades e qualificações abaixo. Mackay se originou e está sediada nos EUA, é necessário ter proficiência em falar, ler e escrever em inglês.


Resumo do Trabalho de Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo:

Sob supervisão limitada, os Técnico de Serviços em Maritimo (MST) instalam, fazem manutenção e reparam equipamentos eletrônicos marítimos a bordo de navios comerciais e navais, iates e embarcações de recreio. Eles testam, ajustam e solucionam problemas de componentes, PCBs, subconjuntos e antenas, bem como carregam, atualizam e modificam o software. title: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho
description:
Somos o Grupo SADA! Um grupo referência em transporte e logística, além de atuação em diversos segmentos de negócios movidos por milhares de pessoas dispostas a darem o seu melhor, todos os dias. Somos serviços, informação, indústria, concessionárias, energia limpa, esporte e responsabilidade social movimentando a vida das pessoas há mais de 45 anos, e é isso que nos faz ir mais longe.


Venha para uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil. Uma empresa que cuida das pessoas e se preocupa em proporcionar um ambiente de trabalho cada vez mais saudável e seguro, pois queremos que nossos colaboradores sempre sintam orgulho de trabalhar aqui.

Somos plurais por natureza, um grupo diverso em negócios e pessoas. Acreditamos que as diferenças somam e movimentam, e é por isso que o Grupo SADA quer conhecer você. Todas as nossas vagas são extensivas as Pessoas com Deficiência e profissionais reabilitados do INSS. Quem sabe alguma oportunidade combina com você.

Se você busca atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e foco em segurança do trabalho, esta vaga pode ser ideal para você!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Segurança do Trabalho III com forte atuação operacional, capacidade analítica e comprometimento com a cultura de prevenção. Atuar na gestão de Segurança do Trabalho III em operações logísticas, com foco na prevenção de acidentes, controle de riscos críticos (prensamento, queda, movimentação de cargas e interação homem x máquina) e garantia de conformidade legal, contribuindo diretamente para a redução de incidentes e melhoria da performance operacional.


Oportunidade: Técnico de Segurança do Trabalho III

Local do Trabalho: R. Carlos Seidl, 993 - Caju, Rio de Janeiro - RJ, .

Modelo de Trabalho: 100% Presencial - Horário: 07:30 às 17:30


TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO III – GRUPO SADA


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Garantir cumprimento das Normas Regulamentadoras (NR 01, 06, 11, 12, 20, 33 e 35) e legislações aplicáveis ao transporte de cargas.
  • Elaborar, revisar e gerir documentos técnicos:
  • PGR, APR, PT, relatórios e indicadores de SST
  • Realizar inspeções de campo em operações logísticas (pátio, carregamento, descarregamento, amarração de cargas, movimentação de contêineres).
  • Identificar e controlar riscos críticos, principalmente:
  • Prensamento de membros
  • Falta de bloqueio/LOTO
  • Quedas de altura
  • Falhas na interação homem x máquina
  • Conduzir investigação de acidentes com foco em causa raiz (Brainstorming, Diagrama de Ishikawa, 5 Porquês).
  • Desenvolver e ministrar treinamentos técnicos e operacionais.
  • Gerenciar EPIs e apoiar especificação de EPCs conforme riscos da operação.
  • Atuar na gestão de dados e sistemas de SST (ex: SOC).
  • Apoiar auditorias, simulados de emergência e planos de ação.
  • Atuar junto à operação e liderança com foco em disciplina operacional e comportamento seguro.


REQUISITOS NECESSÁRIOS (Obrigatórios):


  • Formação Técnica em Segurança do Trabalho com registro no MTE.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos na área.
  • Sólido conhecimento em NRs aplicáveis à operação logística.
  • Experiência com:
  • Gestão de PGR, APR e indicadores
  • Investigação de acidentes
  • Atuação em campo (perfil operacional)
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de gestão (preferencialmente SOC).
  • Domínio do Pacote Office.


COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS:


  • Forte atuação em campo (não apenas administrativo)
  • Capacidade de identificar riscos e propor soluções práticas
  • Boa comunicação e influência sobre equipes operacionais
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com foco em resultado
  • Postura firme em segurança (valor inegociável)


REQUISITOS DIFERENCIAIS:


  • Experiência com transporte de cargas perigosas (ANTT)
  • Experiência com:
  • Logística e transporte rodoviário de cargas
  • Operações com veículos pesados ou contêineres
  • Carretas cegonha
  • Operações de carga/descarga de veículos
  • Amarração de cargas
  • Conhecimento em LOTO (bloqueio e etiquetagem)
  • Vivência com ISO 45001 / auditorias
  • Atuação em programas de comportamento seguro


Por que fazer parte do Grupo SADA?


No Grupo SADA , acreditamos que a comunicação é um elo essencial entre pessoas, propósito e resultados. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente desafiador, colaborativo e em constante transformação, onde suas ideias e seu talento podem gerar impacto real.


Venha fazer parte dessa história!

Candidate-se e contribua para fortalecer a marca e a cultura do Grupo SADA.


NOSSA HISTÓRIA


Para contar a história do nosso grupo empresarial precisamos voltar ao Brasil dos anos 70, quando um jovem visionário desembarcava da Europa trazendo objetivos bem audaciosos. Ali, iniciava a trajetória da SADA, com a implantação de uma pequena transportadora na região metropolitana de Belo Horizonte.


Fundada em 4 de agosto de 1976, na cidade de Contagem, em Minas Gerais, a SADA Transportes e Armazéns S/A é criada, a partir da necessidade de atender as demandas de armazenagem e distribuição automobilística no país.


Sete anos depois, em 1983, a empresa é transferida para Betim em um terreno de cerca de 31 mil metros quadrados, 23 vezes menor que a área ocupada pela empresa atualmente.

“Ainda muito jovem, cheguei aqui vindo da Itália com a tarefa de montar a SADA no Brasil junto com a chegada da Fiat”, conta Vittorio Medioli, fundador presidente do Grupo SADA.


Assim como seu precursor, a origem do nome SADA também é italiana.

description:

RxDiet is a healthcare technology company that provides medically tailored groceries and clinical behavioral health interventions for patients. title: Sr. AI Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $5,000 - $6,500 USD



Along with our partner, we are seeking an engineer who takes prototypes to production: hardening, deploying, iterating with real users, and owning the full delivery pipeline. You’re the person who makes AI products real.


The role:

They have prototypes that work. What they don’t have is a dedicated engineer to take them to production. You’ll take existing foundations, harden them into production-grade applications, deploy them, and iterate based on real user feedback. You’ll also prototype new AI-powered features and capabilities alongside your director.


This is an engineering execution role, not a product management role. You’ll make technical decisions about AI behavior, implement LLM tool-use flows for non-technical hotel operators, and own the entire delivery pipeline from working prototype to deployed, monitored, production application.


What you’ll do:

  • Take prototypes to production.  The prototypes exist a conversational BI tool with NL2SQL and a portfolio-level operations dashboard. You’ll add auth, monitoring, error handling, test coverage, and deploy them for real users.
  • Own AI engineering decisions.  Implement how the LLM interacts with users tool-use flows, NL2SQL generation, streaming UX, error recovery, conversation lifecycle. You have opinions about this, not just implementation skills.
  • Build full-stack.  Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, TypeScript end-to-end. Frontend components, API routes, Snowflake queries you move across the stack as needed.
  • Harden and deploy.  CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps), Azure AD authentication, error handling, test coverage, performance optimization. Make prototypes production-safe.
  • Close the loop with stakeholders.  Work with their director and the product team to translate user feedback into engineering iterations. You won’t be customer-facing, but you’ll be close to the feedback and responsible for acting on it.
  • Manage and extend the verified query set.  Their NL2SQL accuracy is powered by example-led generation a curated library of verified queries that constrain LLM output. You’ll add to it, run gap analyses, and use it as the primary lever for improving answer accuracy.
  • Close the feedback loop.  User signals acknowledgments, ratings, corrections feed back into system quality. You’ll design pipelines that route those signals to verified query sets, prompt refinement, or evaluation frameworks so the system improves measurably with use.
  • Work with AI agents.  Their development workflow uses Claude Code with specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md-driven conventions, and Design → Build → Review pipelines. You’ll adopt and improve this system.


Tech you’ll work with:

  • Application layer:  TypeScript, Angular 19/21, Fastify 5, Node.js, React
  • Monorepo and standalone app structures. SSE streaming, Zustand/NgRx state management, ECharts, Material UI.
  • AI / LLM integration:  Gemini (Vertex AI), Claude API, Tool-use patterns, SSE streaming, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
  • Text-to-Specification patterns the LLM classifies and parameterizes against a semantic layer rather than writing raw SQL. dbt semantic layer for metric definitions and dimension catalogs. MCP server architecture serving data retrieval across multiple products.
  • Data layer:  Snowflake, dbt, Data Vault 2.0
  • You don’t need to be a data engineer, but you’ll write Snowflake queries and understand the Data Vault model backing their analytics.
  • Infrastructure:  Azure, Azure DevOps, Azure AD
  • CI/CD pipelines, cloud hosting, SSO authentication. You’ll own the path from merged PR to running in production.


What they’re looking for:

Must-haves

  • AI engineering experience. You’ve built and shipped applications that use LLMs not just wrappers around ChatGPT, but real tool-use flows, structured generation, or agent systems.
  • You have opinions about when to stream vs. batch, when to ask for clarification vs. infer, and how to handle LLM errors gracefully.
  • Full-stack TypeScript. Strong in Angular (their primary customer-facing framework). React experience is a plus but Angular is the requirement. Solid Node.js/Fastify backend skills. You can own a feature from database query to rendered UI.
  • Production shipping muscle. You’ve taken something from “it works on my machine” to “it’s running in production with real users.” CI/CD, monitoring, auth, error handling the foundational work that makes software real.
  • Direct communication. You ask questions before building. You push back on vague requirements. You say “this seems wrong” when it does. No yes-people.
  • AI agent systems experience. You’ve built, managed, or worked extensively with AI agent systems multi-agent orchestration, tool-use pipelines, or agentic development workflows. Their entire dev process runs through 30+ specialist AI agents; you need to be comfortable operating in and improving that system.
  • AI-assisted development. Comfortable working with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, etc.) as a core part of your workflow, not a novelty.
  • Multi-tenant AI safety. You understand the difference between enforcing data isolation at the LLM layer (fragile) versus the data connection layer (robust) and why that distinction matters when customer data can never cross boundaries.


Nice-to-haves:

  • Hospitality industry experience or multi-property portfolio analytics
  • Snowflake / SQL analytics experience
  • Experience with SSE or WebSocket-based real-time UX
  • Azure cloud platform experience
  • LLM observability and evaluation frameworks (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, or similar) instrumenting AI pipelines to track faithfulness and relevancy, not just uptime


How our partner works:

Their development workflow is AI-native. They use Claude Code with 30+ specialist AI agents, CLAUDE.md project conventions, and a Design → Build → Review pipeline. Every feature goes through product design agents before coding and security + QA agents after. This isn’t optional it’s how they ship quality at speed with a small team.

  • Small team, high autonomy. You report directly to the Director of Data Engineering. Minimal process, maximum ownership.
  • Real data only. No mock data in any environment. APIs return errors when Snowflake is down, not fake arrays. Empty states say “not yet available,” not fake numbers.
  • Documentation as code. CLAUDE.md files, architecture docs, and API route docs are living documents that stay in sync with the codebase.
  • Quality gates. Security review + QA review after every implementation round. Non-negotiable.


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to build production-grade AI products at the forefront of agent-driven technology.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Email Graphic Designer
description:
Company Description

IM Digital is a forward-thinking commerce consultancy dedicated to helping world-class brands build their digital foundation, optimize operations, and drive revenue growth. Through innovative strategies, the company creates value with speed and scale, ensuring clients are equipped to navigate an ever-evolving digital landscape. As a trusted partner, IM Digital provides expert guidance and solutions to accelerate success.


About the Role

We are looking for a Email Graphic Designer to lead and elevate creative execution across our Retention & Lifecycle Marketing team. This role is ideal for a highly skilled designer who not only produces exceptional email creative but also drives efficiency through design systems, mentors junior talent, and contributes to broader marketing storytelling through high-impact visual content.


You will play a key role in shaping how brands communicate with their customers across email and lifecycle channels—while also extending creative into thought leadership assets such as case studies, one-pagers, and slide decks used across LinkedIn and other marketing channels.


As part of our Creative Guild , you’ll collaborate with cross-functional creative leaders across UI/UX, branding, and digital experience to continuously evolve our standards and capabilities.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and execution of high-performing email campaigns and automated lifecycle programs across multiple clients
  • Translate marketing strategy into compelling, conversion-focused creative that aligns with brand guidelines
  • Develop polished one-pagers, case studies, and presentation decks for use in marketing, sales, and thought leadership (e.g., LinkedIn, blog content)
  • Own and evolve email design systems , including reusable components, templates, and documentation to improve speed and consistency
  • Collaborate closely with strategists, campaign managers, developers, and other creatives to deliver best-in-class lifecycle experiences
  • Oversee the preparation and handoff of designs in Figma for seamless implementation across platforms
  • Incorporate and optimize AI-driven workflows (e.g., generative imagery, copy, and layout exploration)
  • Configure and refine AI agents to generate content aligned with brand voice and creative standards
  • Analyze creative performance and iterate based on insights to continuously improve results
  • Manage multiple projects and timelines across a portfolio of clients

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Mentor and provide guidance to Junior Email Graphic Designers , supporting skill development and creative quality
  • Conduct design reviews and provide constructive, actionable feedback
  • Help establish and uphold creative best practices across the team
  • Contribute to onboarding and training materials for new creative team members

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in email design, digital design, or lifecycle marketing creative
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma and strong command of design systems and component-based design
  • Proven ability to create visually compelling marketing assets beyond email (e.g., decks, case studies, one-pagers)

title: Solutions Architect – Data Services
description:
Job Title: Solutions Architect – Data Services

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: Through December 2026 (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: EST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Solutions Architect – Data Services to lead the design and delivery of enterprise-scale data solutions for a global consulting environment. This role is responsible for defining end-to-end architectures across modern data platforms, ensuring alignment with business objectives, governance standards, and enterprise architecture principles.


The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in Azure Databricks , data engineering, and cloud-native architectures, along with hands-on experience in data mesh , data products , and Unity Catalog–based governance . This is a hands-on architect role , requiring both strategic thinking and practical execution through proof-of-concepts (POCs) and close collaboration with engineering teams.


Key Responsibilities


Solution & Data Architecture

  • Define and own solution-level architectures across data platforms, with a focus on Azure Databricks (workspaces, compute, orchestration).
  • Design and implement data mesh architectures and domain-oriented data products.
  • Establish governance frameworks using Unity Catalog , including security, lineage, and multi-workspace strategies.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready data solutions.
  • Identify cross-system dependencies, integration points, and architectural risks.


Data Platform Design & Governance

  • Define best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and serving within Databricks.
  • Establish standards for data product ownership, contracts, and lifecycle management.
  • Implement enterprise-grade security and access control using Unity Catalog, Entra ID, and cloud-native tools.
  • Ensure alignment with enterprise governance, compliance, and security policies.
  • Contribute to reusable architecture patterns and platform standards.


Hands-on Execution & Proof-of-Concepts

  • Design and execute POCs to validate architectural decisions and reduce delivery risk.
  • Remain hands-on with:
  • Python for data engineering, notebooks, and automation
  • C# / Python for APIs, integrations, and platform services
  • Support engineering teams by reviewing designs, resolving technical challenges, and ensuring architectural alignment.


Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

  • Partner with Product Management and business stakeholders to shape features and solution direction.
  • Collaborate with System Architects to align solution and system-level designs.
  • Guide Agile teams through architecture decisions during planning and execution.
  • Participate in architecture reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship

  • Provide guidance and mentorship to architects, tech leads, and senior engineers.
  • Promote best practices in data architecture, engineering, and cloud platform design.
  • Lead design reviews, technical discussions, and knowledge-sharing sessions.


Architecture Documentation

  • Develop architecture artifacts including C4 models and design documentation.
  • Create High-Level Designs (HLDs) and Low-Level Designs (LLDs), including sequence diagrams and data flows.
  • Document functional and non-functional requirements aligned with architectural designs.


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture roles.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering data platforms on Azure Databricks .
  • Strong understanding of data mesh concepts and domain-oriented data products.
  • Hands-on experience with Unity Catalog (governance, security, lineage).
  • Solid programming experience in Python and/or C# , including API and integration design.
  • Experience designing end-to-end solutions across data platforms, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native architectures, DevOps practices, and operational considerations.
  • Experience creating architectural artifacts and design documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to operate in complex environments with ambiguity and evolving requirements.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Solutions Architect, System Architect, or Senior Technical Lead .
  • Experience working in consulting or large enterprise environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe) and PI Planning.
  • Experience with diagram-as-code tools such as Structurizr, PlantUML, or Mermaid.


Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with a hands-on, delivery-focused mindset
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Ability to bridge business and technical stakeholders
  • Leadership and mentorship capabilities
  • Continuous learning and innovation mindset

Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:


Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada.
